title: Modèle — un quartier de ville, commandé depuis sa seule fiche d'atlas
subject: the place described above, as a street of it: its paving, the walls, doors and windows of its buildings, and the objects that make it recognisable, all drawn from the description and nothing from elsewhere

floor.description: a flat floor tile filling its blue diamond outline exactly, as wide and as tall as the outline, never flatter, nothing above it

tall.description: an object or wall piece standing on one diamond, at most one wall height tall

wide.description: a large piece standing on two diamonds in a row
